recovered_calculations.ui_weight: Difficulty × Priority, separate from candidate score.
recovered_calculations.candidate: round(0.75 × marginal route-spread penalty + 0.25 × group difficulty + 0 × group priority, 2)
recovered_calculations.route_spread: With more than one group proximity record: round(0.75 × route_x range + 0.25 × route_y range + 8 × max(distinct clusters − 1, 0), 2); marginal increase clamped to at least zero.
recovered_calculations.difficulty: Active manual_load_points override, otherwise sum of active individual difficulty ratings (missing defaults 1). Bonobos override 75 supersedes raw individual difficulty sum 16 in this function.
recovered_calculations.limits: Installed definitions retrieved, NOT executed. No Haversine/common 0–100 normalization in this chain; internal x/y 75/25 differs from proximity/difficulty 75/25. This is not a runtime-tested employee score.
